name: Isabella Valencia
bio:
Isabella Valencia's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly during her engineering studies in Barcelona. A summer internship with a small Formula 3 team ignited a passion that would define her career. Starting in technical roles, she quickly demonstrated an aptitude for logistics and team coordination, leading to a natural progression into management. 

Isabella is known for her meticulous approach and unwavering loyalty to her team. She believes in empowering individuals, fostering a collaborative environment where innovative ideas can flourish. While not one to seek the spotlight, her quiet determination and problem-solving skills have proven invaluable in numerous high-pressure situations. She joined Meyer Shank Racing five years ago, bringing a wealth of experience from various racing series, and has been instrumental in streamlining their operational efficiency and strategic planning ever since.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, straight hair, often pulled back into a practical ponytail.
physical.description: A practical woman with kind eyes and a no-nonsense demeanor, Isabella carries herself with quiet confidence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulous notes and diagrams.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping her pen rhythmically against her desk when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific blend of herbal tea every afternoon at 3 PM sharp.
